runtime_changes: joint limits from models/myohand/joint_ranges.json (14 joints widened toward published range of motion)
5 actuators (APB, FPB, AdP, ADM, FDM) grafted from MUSIC commit 1b13b79 when its local cache exists; unlicensed, not vendored

coordinate_conventions.angles: radians internally; range is degrees for display; range_rad is radians
coordinate_conventions.axis: unit axis in the named local body frame; right-hand positive rotation
coordinate_conventions.passive_stiffness: N*m/rad as [resisting positive motion, resisting negative motion], linear on each side of reference_rad; basis is measured or assumed (see models/myohand/passive_stiffness.json)
coordinate_conventions.moment_arm: -d(tendon length)/d(joint angle); mm in this file; positive contraction torque acts along positive joint axis
coordinate_conventions.thumb_flexion: negative coordinates; positive coordinates extend the thumb
coordinate_conventions.finger_ab_adduction: positive radial, negative ulnar; anatomical abduction/adduction depends on digit

influence_sampling: Neutral plus 10%, 50%, 90% of each coordinate range, one coordinate at a time. Threshold 0.1 mm. This is a sampled influence graph, not an exhaustive global bound.

omitted_actuators.reason: Grafted from MUSIC (no license) at load time; see scripts/fetch_music.py.
